edits.old: Then the system refuses the approval with 409 and MSG-P7-002
edits.new:
Then the system refuses the approval with 409 and MSG-P7-002

  Scenario: AC8 A role without the right is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a user without the right to read the report or to approve a version
    When that user requests the report of evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001"
    Then the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC9 BR3 A mode or a status outside the list in force is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock returns LOV-AUTONOMY with OFF, SHADOW and L1 and LOV-CONFIG-STATUS with LOADED, APPROVED and RETIRED
    Given a policy file with a mode that is not in LOV-AUTONOMY
    When RW-COE loads it
    Then the system refuses the load with 422 and MSG-P10-001 naming the list and the value

  Scenario: AC10 BR5 The report holds no personal field in any format (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the report of evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001"
    When the report is written as JSON, CSV and PDF
    Then none of the three holds a personal field, a customer identifier, a party identifier or an account identifier

  Scenario: AC11 BR7 Parameters and lists come only through the rwb-case contracts (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case parameters contract mock returns the minimum sample 200 for an autonomy step in force
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock returns LOV-AUTONOMY with OFF, SHADOW and L1
    When RW-COE loads policy "INTAKE" version "P2" with mode "L1" and evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001"
    Then the load reads no table of rwb_case and no value of a parameter or a list from code

  Scenario: AC12 BR8 The load writes agent_policy only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the report of evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001"
    When RW-COE loads policy "INTAKE" version "P2" with mode "L1" and evaluation run "EV-INTAKE-001"
    Then the system writes one agent_policy row in rwb_agent and no other row
